_about: How every host (Mac, Modal, Qoherent's GPU) runs llama-server. Change settings here and nowhere else, so results stay comparable across hosts.

llama_cpp.why: Has Nanbeige4.2 support (PR #25994), its tool-call fix (PR #26252) and the Metal fix for macOS 14/15 (PR #31360; release 0.8.0 fails on this Mac). Every host must run this same build.

nanbeige42.sha256_why: Files made by convert/to_gguf.sh from source.revision with the pinned build. BF16 comes from plain Python and must match on every machine. Quantizing can round differently on different processors, so q8_0/q4_k_m keep one reference per platform (uname -s, uname -m); null = not recorded yet, and the first conversion there prints the value to add (colab/COLAB_PLAN.md).
nanbeige42.chat_template_why: the model's own template, changed only to accept GRC-Agent's two leading system messages (see templates/README.md)
nanbeige42.extra_args_why: server defaults from the model's generation_config.json; a client that sends temperature etc. overrides them
